base_pose: standing upright on two legs, arms relaxed at the sides

walk.action: walking forward upright on two legs
walk.suffix: , performing a full walk cycle in place: the legs striding heel-to-toe one after the other, arms swinging in opposition to the legs, hips counter-rotating, torso held upright, classic looping sprite walk animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: upright on two legs, mid-stride, one leg forward with the heel landing and the other pushing off behind, opposite arms swinging, torso vertical, head level

idle.suffix: , weight shifting from one foot to the other, head turning to look around, chest rising and falling with slow breathing, shoulders settling, gentle looping idle animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: standing upright on two legs, idling and looking bored, arms folded across the chest, head turned to one side, eyes open

run.suffix: , the legs driving through a full running stride with the knees lifting high, arms bent and pumping in opposition, hips counter-rotating quickly, energetic looping run animation, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: upright on two legs, mid-run stride, one knee driven up high and the other leg extended behind, arms bent and pumping, chest up, head forward

sleep.action: asleep on the ground, breathing slowly
sleep.suffix: , chest rising and falling with each slow breath, one shoulder settling with the rhythm, a hand twitching now and then, eyes staying closed throughout, calm looping sleep animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: a two-legged figure lying asleep on one side, legs bent, arms folded in front, head resting down, eyes closed

sit.action: sitting down on the ground, relaxed
sit.suffix: , chest rising and falling with slow breathing, head turning to glance around, hands resting and shifting on the knees, shoulders settling, gentle looping animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: sitting upright on the ground, two legs bent in front with the feet flat, back straight, hands resting on the knees, head raised

eat.action: eating something held in both hands
eat.suffix: , both hands raising the food to the mouth and lowering it again, jaw working while chewing, head nodding slightly with each bite, elbows bending and straightening, small looping feeding animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: standing upright on two legs, both hands holding food up to the open mouth, head tilted forward, elbows bent

jump.action: jumping straight up in an excited burst
jump.suffix: , crouching then driving off both legs and throwing both arms up overhead, the body extending upward then landing and bending at the knees, one reaction jump, no horizontal movement, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: upright on two legs, airborne mid-jump, both arms thrown up overhead, knees tucked up, body stretched upward

play.action: waving hello with one hand and grinning
play.suffix: , one hand waving side to side above the shoulder, the other hand staying down at the side, shoulders shifting with the wave, head turning to follow it, lively reaction loop, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: standing upright on two legs, waving hello with one raised hand, the other hand down at the side, head turned toward the viewer, grinning

fly.action: flying through the air with one arm extended forward
fly.suffix: , clothing and hair streaming back in the wind, the extended arm holding steady while the trailing arm and the legs shift with the airflow, torso held straight and level, steady looping flight animation, hovering in place, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: a two-legged figure airborne in flight, body stretched out level, one arm extended forward and the other trailing back, legs straight and together, head raised looking forward
